AgentAnswerRequest.description: `agent.answer`: answer a pending provider request by its ID.

answers.description: Structured answers; required by the `answer` decision.

AgentSendRequest.description: `agent.send`: submit a prompt. `request_id` is the caller-owned operation ID.

CatalogFrame.description: The `catalog.get` reply and the `catalog` feed frame.

CatalogGetRequest.description: `catalog.get`: read the profile's workspaces, conversations and windows.

ConversationGetRequest.description: `conversation.get`: one page of a conversation's messages, newest first.

before.description: Return messages with a sequence below this one.

limit.description: Page size; the daemon uses 50 when it is absent.

Descriptor.description:
The daemon advertises the same contract it uses to validate configuration.
Clients consume descriptors; they do not infer support from a provider name.

ExecutionState.description: Whether a service's recorded run is live in the current runtime.

ListenerListRequest.description: `listener.list`: observe local TCP listeners and service port assignments.

workspace_id.description: Set when the listener belongs to a verified managed service run.

PortAssignment.description: One service port assignment and who was seen listening on it.

Readiness.description: Port readiness; application readiness is never inferred.

ReadinessState.description: What the daemon could observe about a running service's ports.

config.description:
Inlined in schemas: a request's defaults make its required fields differ
from a reply's, so the two cannot share one named definition.

peers.description: Environment variables populated from another managed service in this workspace.

ports.description: Environment variables that receive stable, host-local TCP ports.

identity.description: Durable incarnation; a removed service with the same name gets a new ID.

launch_peers.description: URLs placed in the environment of the currently reserved service run.

ServiceChanged.description: The `service_changed` feed frame, sent when a run starts or stops.

metrics.description: The launched terminal's metrics; present when a run starts.

ServiceConfigureRequest.description: `service.configure`: create or edit a service recipe.

config.description:
Decoded as a [`Config`] by the handler, so malformed recipes keep the
daemon's own validation messages.

peers.description: Environment variables populated from another managed service in this workspace.

ports.description: Environment variables that receive stable, host-local TCP ports.

revision.description: The revision the caller last saw; 0 creates the service.

metrics.description: The runtime terminal metrics, or null when the service has no live terminal.

ServiceHealthSampleRequest.description: `service.health.sample`: probe the service's configured health policy now.

ServiceInspectRequest.description: `service.inspect`: execution, readiness, peers and bounded output of one service.

health_check.description:
A one-off HTTP probe. The handler validates it, so its messages stay
specific.

tail_bytes.description: Output tail in bytes, 1 to 32768; the daemon uses 8192 when it is absent.

current_peer_endpoints.description: Absent when the service changed during inspection.

durable_logs.description: The durable run log tail, or `{available: false, reason}`.

health.description: The requested one-off probe result; present when `health_check` was sent.

health_monitor.description: The configured policy's latest monitored result.

logs.description: The live terminal tail, or `{available: false, reason}`.

ServiceListRequest.description: `service.list`: a workspace's services and their execution state.

ServiceProxy.description:
A stable URL. The `service.proxy.ensure`, `service.proxy.inspect`,
`service.proxy.remap` and `service.proxy.recovery.retry` reply.

availability.description: Present, as `port_occupied`, only from `service.proxy.inspect` on a blocked route.

url.description: Null when the route's port is occupied.

ServiceProxyEnsureRequest.description: `service.proxy.ensure`: create or reuse the stable URL for one service port.

reason.description: Present when the registry is corrupt.

registry_sha256.description: Present when the registry is corrupt; empty when no bounded digest exists.

ServiceProxyRecoveryInspectRequest.description: `service.proxy.recovery.inspect`: blocked routes or a corrupt registry.

archive.description: Path of the archived corrupt registry.

ServiceProxyRecoveryResetRequest.description: `service.proxy.recovery.reset`: archive and reset an inspected corrupt registry.

ServiceProxyRecoveryRetryRequest.description: `service.proxy.recovery.retry`: rebind a blocked route's original port.

ServiceProxyRemapRequest.description:
`service.proxy.remap`: point a stable URL at the service's current identity
and port, only if both reviewed targets still match.

ServiceProxyRetireRequest.description: `service.proxy.retire`: retire exactly one reviewed stable URL.

ServiceProxyRetired.description: The `service.proxy.retire` reply: the route as it was retired.

reason.description: Why the port is unavailable; present when it is occupied.

url.description: Null when the route's port is occupied.

ServiceProxyTarget.description: The `service.proxy.target` reply: the verified service process to forward to.

ServiceProxyTargetRequest.description:
`service.proxy.target`: the runtime proxy asks the daemon to verify its
target before forwarding one connection.

ServiceRemoveRequest.description: `service.remove`: delete a stopped service at the revision the caller saw.

effective_peers.description: Peer URLs placed in the run's environment; present on `service.start`.

metrics.description: The launched terminal's metrics; present on `service.start`.

ServiceStartRequest.description: `service.start`: launch a configured service, or return its live run.

ServiceStopRequest.description: `service.stop`: stop a service and confirm its process exited.
